question: Bombay Stock Exchange is the ________ stock exchange of Asia.
solution:
The correct answer is **__first.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **BSE is Asia's first and the Fastest Stock Exchange in the world with a speed of 6 microseconds and is one of India's leading exchange groups.**
 
• In 2013, BSE upgraded its technology platform to Bolt Plus, which is based on the business architecture of the global giant Deutsche Borse.
 
• As of now January 2022 the chairman of the** Bombay Stock Exchange is Vikramajit Sen.**
 
• Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE), is an Indian stock exchange located on Dalal Street in Mumbai.
 
• Bombay Stock Exchange is the** oldest stock exchange in Asia, and also the tenth oldest in the world.**
 
• The Bombay Stock Exchange is the** 9th largest stock exchange with an overall market capitalization of more than Rs 255.003 lakh crore, as of October 2021.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **BSE was established in 1875 as the native share and Stock broker' Association.**

 
 
• It enables investors to trade in **equities, currencies, debt instruments, derivatives, and mutual funds.**
 
• It also provides other important capital market trading services such as risk management, clearing, settlement, and investor education.
 
• In 1995, the BSE switched from an open floor to an electronic trading system.
 
• The BSE's overall performance is measured by the Sensex, a benchmark index of 30 of the BSE's largest and most actively traded stocks covering 12 sectors.
 
• The index broadly represents the composition of India's entire market.
 
• The Bombay Stock Exchange is** located on Dalal Street in downtown Mumbai, India.**
 
 
 
• **Kolkata Share market **was established in 1908.
 
• **Ahmedabad Share market** was established as a Public Charitable Trust in 1894.
